explanation: Eta channel cos(θ*) scan generated successfully. 5 points spanning cos(θ*) from -0.999 to +0.999 at W=1.7 GeV, Q²=1.5 GeV², φ*=90° using full O(α) radiative corrections at beam energy 6.53 GeV (CLAS12 RG-K, the validated eta campaign). All kinematics passed preflight validation. The scan avoids the poles at ±1.0 where the integration would fail.
